classifications.rationale: The President immediately assigns the exercise of U.S. governmental powers over the Ryukyu Islands to the Secretary of Defense, subject to presidential control; this is an internal delegation and allocation of executive authority, not a dictated later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The said powers shall be exercised by the Secretary of Defense, subject to the direction and control of the President of the United States.

classifications.rationale: The segment directs cabinet officials’ administration, permits delegation, assigns foreign-relations responsibility, and establishes an executive administrative body; these are immediate organizational and managerial measures rather than substantive changes to private legal rights.
classifications.evidence: There is established, under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of Defense, a civil administration of the Ryukyu Islands

classifications.rationale: The segment prescribes appointment, duties, and delegation for the High Commissioner, allocating internal governmental authority without itself imposing a substantive legal consequence on regulated persons.
classifications.evidence: The High Commissioner (a) shall be designated by the Secretary of Defense

classifications.rationale: The President presently continues the Ryukyuan government and directly vests legislative power in an elected body while fixing its composition, election cycle, and legislative jurisdiction; those governmental powers and legal structures arise from the segment itself.
classifications.evidence: The legislative power of the Government of the Ryukyu Islands, except as otherwise provided in this order, shall be vested in a legislative body whose members are directly elected by the people of the islands.

classifications.rationale: The segment itself confers rulemaking and membership-qualification authority on the central legislature and municipal legislative power on local bodies, presently establishing legally operative governmental powers.
classifications.evidence: Local legislative bodies, the members of which shall be elected by the inhabitants of the respective municipalities in accordance with procedures established by the legislative body of the Government of the Ryukyu Islands, shall be given and shall exercise appropriate municipal legislative powers.

classifications.rationale: The segment requires the High Commissioner to transmit enacted laws to the Secretary of Defense; this is an internal reporting duty whose consequence occurs upon reporting, not a substantive legal change.
classifications.evidence: The High Commissioner shall report to the Secretary of Defense all laws enacted by the legislative body of the Government of the Ryukyu Islands

classifications.rationale: Although it includes reporting and administrative duties, the segment itself establishes executive, legislative, and judicial powers and procedures, directly determines when bills become law, and presently allocates civil and criminal jurisdiction; these provisions have self-executing legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: These courts shall exercise jurisdiction as follows: (1) Civil jurisdiction in all civil cases
